name: Standing Biceps Stretch
instructions: Clasp your hands behind your back with your palms together, straighten arms and then rotate them so your palms face downward.
Raise your arms up and hold until you feel a stretch in your biceps.
prompt: This is a Standing Biceps Stretch for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the biceps. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Clasp your hands behind your back with your palms together, straighten arms and then rotate them so your palms face downward. Raise your arms up and hold until you feel a stretch in your biceps."
